say:1:1720912001:1.text: Go on, open it. Let's see what they've been hiding in there.
say:1:1720912001:1.source_cn: 快打开看看，里面有什么？

say:3:1720912002:1.text: Right away, sir! I'll crack it open...

choice_prompt:4:1720912002.text: Right away, sir! I'll crack it open...

say:5:1720912003:1.text: Aah! I'm sorry! It was Mr. Maska's idea! He told me to steal your mailbox!
say:5:1720912003:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊！同行老师，我错了，对不起，是马斯卡老师安排我偷...
say:5:1720912003:1.male: Aah! I'm sorry! It was Mr. Maska's idea! He told me to steal your mailbox!
say:5:1720912003:1.female: Aah! I'm sorry! It was Mr. Maska's idea! He told me to steal your mailbox!

say:6:1720912005:1.text: Haria, wow! I leave you alone for two seconds and you rat me out. There goes your internship review!
say:6:1720912005:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇，你真是没用！这么容易就……我要在实习评价上给你...

say:7:1720912006:1.text: Now then, my fellow reporter. Let's not turn this into a bigger issue than it is.
say:7:1720912006:1.source_cn: 那个……《赛凡纳之眼》的同仁，这只是个小意外。
say:7:1720912006:1.male: Now then, my fellow reporter. Let's not turn this into a bigger issue than it is.
say:7:1720912006:1.female: Now then, my fellow reporter. Let's not turn this into a bigger issue than it is.

say:8:1720912007:1.text: I'm with the Savannah Morning Post. This mailbox was... taken by mistake. Yes. An unfortunate mix-up!
say:8:1720912007:1.source_cn: 我是隔壁《赛凡纳晨报》的记者，这个信箱……是我们拿错了...

say:9:1720912008:1.text: Haria, how many times have I told you to remember our own pickup point? You can't go around taking the wrong mailbox!
say:9:1720912008:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇，说了多少次，要记住我们报社的信箱地址，怎么能拿...

say:10:1720912009:1.text: Y-Yes, Mr. Maska. My mistake. It won't happen again!
say:10:1720912009:1.source_cn: 是……是我粗心大意了，马斯卡老师，我绝对不会犯第二次错误了！

choice_prompt:11:1720912009.text: Y-Yes, Mr. Maska. My mistake. It won't happen again!
choice_prompt:11:1720912009.source_cn: 是……是我粗心大意了，马斯卡老师，我绝对不会犯第二次错误了！

say:12:1720912010:0.text: What? Then why jump out and scare us like that?
say:12:1720912010:0.source_cn: 啊？!那你突然出现吓我们一跳是想要干什么！
say:12:1720912010:0.male: What? Then why jump out and scare us like that?
say:12:1720912010:0.female: What? Then why jump out and scare us like that?

choice_prompt:13:1720912011.text: So you're not with the Savannah Eye? Then why'd you scare us like that? What do you want?!
choice_prompt:13:1720912011.source_cn: 这么说你不是《赛凡纳之眼》的人？那你突然出现吓我们一跳是想要干什么！
choice_prompt:13:1720912011.male: So you're not with the Savannah Eye? Then why'd you scare us like that? What do you want?!
choice_prompt:13:1720912011.female: So you're not with the Savannah Eye? Then why'd you scare us like that? What do you want?!

say:14:1720912012:0.text: Hey, hey, no need for that! Let's talk before anyone does anything rash.
say:14:1720912012:0.source_cn: 哎，别！有话我们好好说，好好说！

say:15:1720912013:0.text: If you're not with them, then maybe this could still turn into a useful conversation.
say:15:1720912013:0.source_cn: 既然你不是《赛凡纳之眼》的人，那一切都是可以合作，可以...
say:15:1720912013:0.male: If you're not with them, then maybe this could still turn into a useful conversation.
say:15:1720912013:0.female: If you're not with them, then maybe this could still turn into a useful conversation.

say:16:1720912014:0.text: To tell you the truth, our paper's in trouble. We haven't had a real hit in ages. Sales are down, and the editor-in-chief is about ready to throw us out on the street.
say:16:1720912014:0.source_cn: 实话跟你说吧，我们自家报纸写不出爆款头条来，销量不景气...
say:16:1720912014:0.male: To tell you the truth, our paper's in trouble. We haven't had a real hit in ages. Sales are down, and the editor-in-chief is about ready to throw us out on the street.
say:16:1720912014:0.female: To tell you the truth, our paper's in trouble. We haven't had a real hit in ages. Sales are down, and the editor-in-chief is about ready to throw us out on the street.

say:17:1720912015:1.text: I got desperate. Our rival, the Savannah Eye, keeps landing one explosive story after another, so I sent the intern to find out where they were getting their material.
say:17:1720912015:1.source_cn: 我也是被逼得没办法，眼看着人家《赛凡纳之眼》销量红火，...

choice_prompt:18:1720912015.text: I got desperate. Our rival, the Savannah Eye, keeps landing one explosive story after another, so I sent the intern to find out where they were getting their material.
choice_prompt:18:1720912015.source_cn: 我也是被逼得没办法，眼看着人家《赛凡纳之眼》销量红火，才想出让实习生……打探打探竞争对手的消息来源这一招。

say:19:1720912016:1.text: Exactly! We barely get paid, but we still work our butts off chasing stories. And for what? People treat us like a nuisance, and the editor-in-chief chews us out when we get back. And then the first time we try to cut a corner, we get caught.
say:19:1720912016:1.source_cn: 是吧，我们可是初犯！每天就拿着那么一点点薪水，四处奔波...

say:20:1720912017:1.text: Honestly, I almost feel sorry for myself.
say:20:1720912017:1.source_cn: 我自己都觉得自己可怜啊！

say:21:1720912018:1.text: ... A-And I'm not even being paid!

say:22:1720912019:1.text: Haria, you're lucky to even have this internship at all. Just focus on what you can do for the paper.
say:22:1720912019:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇，你能有这个实习机会已经很难得了，多想想你能给报...

say:25:1720912021:1.text: ... You've got something better in mind?
say:25:1720912021:1.male: ... You've got something better in mind?
say:25:1720912021:1.female: ... You've got something better in mind?

choice_prompt:26:1720912021.text: ... You've got something better in mind?
choice_prompt:26:1720912021.male: ... You've got something better in mind?
choice_prompt:26:1720912021.female: ... You've got something better in mind?

say:27:1720912022:1.text: But you just said you weren't a reporter!
say:27:1720912022:1.source_cn: 可你……刚刚还说你不是同行！
say:27:1720912022:1.male: But you just said you weren't a reporter!
say:27:1720912022:1.female: But you just said you weren't a reporter!

choice_prompt:28:1720912022.text: But you just said you weren't a reporter!
choice_prompt:28:1720912022.source_cn: 可你……刚刚还说你不是同行！
choice_prompt:28:1720912022.male: But you just said you weren't a reporter!
choice_prompt:28:1720912022.female: But you just said you weren't a reporter!

say:29:1720912023:1.text: Ah. A private investigator. That actually makes sense. We want stories, you want truth. Close enough.
say:29:1720912023:1.source_cn: 原来如此……私家侦探是吧？我懂了。私家侦探可是记者的好...
say:29:1720912023:1.male: Ah. A private investigator. That actually makes sense. We want stories, you want truth. Close enough.
say:29:1720912023:1.female: Ah. A private investigator. That actually makes sense. We want stories, you want truth. Close enough.

say:30:1720912024:1.text: I knew it. That paper didn't make it this far on luck alone. It came out of nowhere, and somehow they're always first with the story.
say:30:1720912024:1.source_cn: 我就说《赛凡纳之眼》这家报社有问题！不知道什么时候冒出...

say:31:1720912025:1.text: People shut us out, but they somehow get answers. And the places we can't even get close to? They walk right in like they own the place!
say:31:1720912025:1.source_cn: 我们采访不到的信源他们都能采到，我们去不了的新闻现场，...

choice_prompt:32:1720912025.text: People shut us out, but they somehow get answers. And the places we can't even get close to? They walk right in like they own the place!
choice_prompt:32:1720912025.source_cn: 我们采访不到的信源他们都能采到，我们去不了的新闻现场，他们像回家一样！

say:33:1720912026:1.text: No. That's the problem. No one has. No office, no names, no faces. Just stories that keep showing up.
say:33:1720912026:1.source_cn: 那倒是没有，这都是我看到他们的报纸后才知道的，这家报社...

say:34:1720912027:1.text: If I had any other way, I wouldn't be standing here holding a stolen mailbox.
say:34:1720912027:1.source_cn: 要是有别的办法，我也不至于去偷他们征集新闻线索的信箱啊。

say:35:1720912028:0.text: You said we could work together. So what's your plan? Break this thing open and hope something useful falls out?
say:35:1720912028:0.source_cn: 照你的意思，我们是怎么个合作法？一起把信箱砸开看看里面...
say:35:1720912028:0.male: You said we could work together. So what's your plan? Break this thing open and hope something useful falls out?
say:35:1720912028:0.female: You said we could work together. So what's your plan? Break this thing open and hope something useful falls out?

say:36:1720912029:0.text: Looking at Maska, who clearly isn't the sharpest tool in the shed, and Haria, who has already started zoning out, you let out a sigh and begin explaining the plan you just came up with.
say:36:1720912029:0.source_cn: 看着脑子不太灵光的马斯卡和已经明显走神了的赫蒂奇，你无...
say:36:1720912029:0.male: Looking at Maska, who clearly isn't the sharpest tool in the shed, and Haria, who has already started zoning out, you let out a sigh and begin explaining the plan you just came up with.
say:36:1720912029:0.female: Looking at Maska, who clearly isn't the sharpest tool in the shed, and Haria, who has already started zoning out, you let out a sigh and begin explaining the plan you just came up with.

And worse, the moment the mailbox goes missing, the people behind the Savannah Eye will know someone's sniffing around. Once that happens, they'll get careful, and we lose the only lead we have.

say:39:1720912032:0.text: Hold on. Let me make sure I've got this straight.

say:40:1720912033:0.text: We pretend to be informants, feed them a story, and then use that story to draw out whoever's really working behind the scenes?
say:40:1720912033:0.source_cn: 你的意思是，我们装作爆料人向同行爆料线索？之后再顺着线...
say:40:1720912033:0.male: We pretend to be informants, feed them a story, and then use that story to draw out whoever's really working behind the scenes?

say:41:1720912034:0.text: Sir... do you really think that will work?

choice_prompt:44:1720912036.text: That's actually brilliant, detective! I'm utterly impressed!
choice_prompt:44:1720912036.source_cn: ……真是天才啊！术业有专攻，侦探不愧是侦探！

say:46:1720912039:1.text: So do we put the tip in now?

say:47:1720912040:1.text: Right. But what kind of tip are we giving them?

say:48:1720912041:1.text: Sir, what about the lead I was already working on?
say:48:1720912041:1.source_cn: 老师，我跟进的那条新闻线索……

say:49:1720912042:1.text: It's not exactly a great story, but it's something. Go ahead and write it down.
say:49:1720912042:1.source_cn: 嗯，那条线索不错，虽然没什么价值，但也不能说完全没有价...
